chk.text: Kiku leads Uramon's men, and she meets Toshiro Umezawa on his trek through Takenuma and takes him to Uramon.
After the yuki-onna kill her men, she and Marrow-Gnawer are forced to join the Hyozan Reckoners, though Toshi tricks them into helping him neutralize Uramon and steal her Shadow Gate.

When Soratami shinobi and bushi attack the mahotsukai manor, the elders trigger a revenge curse that turns Kiku into a killing machine, and Toshi finds her, spends the night with her and seals the curse in a ceramic tile.

At Minamo, Hidetsugu defeats Kiku bloodlessly, and when Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye the tile breaks and the curse reclaims her, until Toshi stops her from killing Hidetsugu and then sends her through the shadows back to Numai, where her fate is unknown.
